# Structurally valid EU VAT numbers for the :tax_identifier factory.
#
# Core format-checks eu_vat, so a factory cannot invent numbers by counting
# upward: the check digit puts valid ones at irregular intervals. These pass
# the German checksum and nothing more — they identify no business, and no
# registry has been asked about them.
